captureNotes: Real TaskWindow captures of a separate local database loaded from demo/readme-preview.sql (fictional people and .example domains). Provider keys were placeholders, so no vendor was called for data. Dark capture applies the app's existing prefers-color-scheme dark rules through CSSOM; no UI content is replaced. Desktop capture is a 1440×960 emulated viewport.

features.title:
Describe the buyer.
Get named leads.

features.title:
Your vendors.
Your order.
